Nayla's Fable: Lust & Rust is out now! Nayla's an energetic girl who got a part-time job at Sunstone Power Plant, Everything was going perfectly during her first day at work, when she stumbled upon an underground forgotten lab and accidentally released a strange substance with some "serious" aphrodisiac effect. 
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/1b1acd340e09b1c18df825b5b705550c0838b144.png[/img]
Scared to reveal her mistake and get fired, she decides to looks for a solution by herself, with the assistance of a new unexpected friend.

Help Nayla investigate and look for resources while completing her daily work schedules and find a solution to this experimental substance before it's spreads everywhere and affect the entire power plant!

notes.title: Deathblight Jormungandr Announced!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468280/Deathblight_Jormungandr/

The Goddess of Mischief, Loki ventures out to explore and conquer the marshland and its inhabbitants for her own machinations. 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/e4ac44052f3fbe5d940ad1923bcd2e5dece5e8e3.png[/img]

Upon entering the cursed lands, she finds her powers seriously weakened, and the creatures of the swamp to be uncooperative and even hostile.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/25e848bbdb65900d4a9a70f4a873e3e612f289b6.png[/img]

Can Loki beat sense into the goblin tribes and transform the malediction into a power of her own?

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d00a391ca9a73138630230178a40fce4aec2c728.png[/img]

[b]- A very VERY difficult, unusual RPG Maker meets turn-based combat!

- Complex combat system that punishes skill spam

- Enemies that can telegraph their attacks

- Loki needs to use smart tactical counter-attacks based on the situation

- No grinding (you can avoid unnecessary fights)[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468280/Deathblight_Jormungandr/

notes.title: Pyramid Tits DLC & Easter Events!!!
notes.content:
Happy April 1st everyone! This one is going to be a crazy update for Shady Lewd Kart. As its the day of fools we decided to release some content that was lost and forgotten in the early days of Kart. Pyramid Tits was a lost character from the early concept of Kart that parodies a certain raider of tombs. Well now you can play as her in our first official DLC!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579600/Shady_Lewd_Kart__Pyramid_Tits_Character_Pack/
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/9bb4a9a3116794c4d93044d9a5c9b4e863882daa.png[/img]
PT has a full story mode and three unlocks including her damage bubble and panties to collect as well as she is voiced by british babe PixieWillow! So you know its a banger of an update!

Also for your pleasure ALL the Easter Events are back. Every single one! So get out there if you havent and collect those goodies! Lots of characters and lewds to collect!

We also did some polishing of a few things as well as the main loading times for the game so lets see how that feels on your gunked up computer! As always let us know what you think and any bugs keep us informed.

Happy April Fools!

- Shades

notes.title: Lustful Victor Joins Shady Corner!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3326970/Lustful_Victor/
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/2920993492b43cf4c5b685a7c3b88b3e5751816a.png[/img]

In the shadows of Earth's orbit, Noëlle, 18F, awakens aboard the ISS with fragmented memories and a burning desire for vengeance. Descending to Petaputua, a sprawling, neon-lit metropolis, she finds a city drenched in decadence and danger. Here, technology and humanity intertwine in ways both thrilling and forbidden.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d721c74b726577dc89310053f69977a2a72ee054.gif[/img]

Petaputua’s streets are rife with vice and violence. Cybernetic thugs, seductive rogue AIs, and ruthless corporate enforcers dominate the city's underbelly. Each encounter pushes Noëlle to her limits, testing her skills and her resolve.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d038a0f46ca408623df576f0ae217f08e690f1e0.png[/img]

In this city of sin, power comes at a price. Noëlle must navigate a world of corrupt deals and illicit pleasures to gain the upper hand. Grinding for experience and gold is essential, with rewards that go beyond mere survival—upgrading equipment, learning new, provocative skills, and indulging in the city's dark temptations.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/71e33f42f7c2853f8fec612b7d299d4b8d885207.png[/img]

Victor, the enigmatic antagonist, manipulates the chaos from the shadows. His true motives remain hidden, but his influence pervades every corner of Petaputua, driving Noëlle towards a confrontation that promises to be as intimate as it is deadly.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/f50d9fd6ad962dfb36d57edb12137feb6741872f.png[/img]
